status: draft, not approved; RGT-S003 is active and RGT-D-fixture has not been recorded
note: The creative-intent artifact Gate 1 checks. It carries the six Gate 1 fields as data for both productions, plus the stimulation profile RISK-58 requires and the originality statement RISK-10 requires. Narrative content, shot lists and the structured correction live in production-brief.md; this file does not restate them.

audience.viewing_context: co-viewing with an adult; no interaction required from the child
audience.note: [OWNER-STATED] The audience is declared by the Project Owner, not established by research. RGT-S009B was rejected, so no audience evidence will exist. See docs/requirements/charter.md, Charter Revision 1.

safety_constraints.no_flashing: no luminance change exceeding the declared per-shot amplitude within any 1-second window
safety_constraints.no_sudden_loudness: no level step exceeding the declared audio range between adjacent shots
safety_constraints.no_peril: no character is endangered, lost, frightened or alone in distress at any point
safety_constraints.no_on_screen_text: the only text over picture is the lyric layer, which is removable; see production-brief.md
safety_constraints.low_stimulation: the stimulation_profile below is a delivery constraint, not a style note

success_criteria.rubric: the five human-review dimensions in docs/quality/quality-system.md
success_criteria.threshold: average of at least 4 out of 5, from charter Objective 4
success_criteria.blocking: zero blocking findings at any gate
success_criteria.note: [OWNER-STATED] Scored by the Project Owner. Blind review is waived, so the score is an owner self-assessment; state that limitation wherever it is used.

factual_source_expectations.reason: Both productions are fictional narratives about an original cast. Neither asserts a fact about the world, so no factual source is required and the factual-accuracy validator has nothing to resolve against.
factual_source_expectations.consequence: A production that later introduces a factual claim — counting, naming a real place, stating how something works — must add its sources here before Gate 1 passes. The empty list is a declaration, not an absence.

originality.subject: original
originality.music: original, and not yet produced; see production-brief.md, Audio dependency
originality.statement: No protected character, artwork, music or brand identity is copied. No reference channel supplied a subject, a storyline, a character or an asset. Reference channels were studied for art direction only.

stimulation_profile.note: Fields are fixed here. Every value is `evidence-pending` and is calibrated by SPIKE-F001's calibration plan, not by this brief. The measured column records what the declared shot list actually produces, so a later limit can be set against a real number rather than an invented one.

motion_amplitude.unit: peak joint angular velocity, degrees per second, per shot
motion_amplitude.measured: not measured; requires a compiled run

colour_intensity.unit: peak chroma and adjacent-shot contrast ratio
colour_intensity.measured: not measured; requires a compiled run

audio_level_range.unit: integrated loudness LUFS and true peak dBTP
audio_level_range.measured: not measured; audio does not exist

productions.title: Carry It Together
productions.purpose: Show turn-taking and shared effort: a thing too awkward for one is easy for three.
productions.declared_storyline: Three friends and a quadruped move one ball across open ground to a cart, passing it between them when each in turn finds it awkward, and finally carrying it together.
productions.declared_concept: a cumulative journey with a destination; each repetition adds a participant and changes the formation

productions.title: Where Did It Go?
productions.purpose: Show searching as a named, orderly activity: look, say where you looked, look somewhere else.
productions.declared_storyline: The ball goes missing. Three friends search three named places in turn, each reporting what they found, until the quadruped reveals it had it all along.
productions.declared_concept: an episodic question-and-answer search with a reveal, no travel and no destination; each repetition returns to the same question from a different place

narrative_axis_separation.requirement: RGT-S009 section 8: YouTube prohibits "a highly similar storyline template across multiple videos" while expressly allowing "Similar content, like a series following a set of characters across episodes… but in which each video has a distinct storyline, focus or concept".
narrative_axis_separation.shared: cast, visual design, palette, environment, asset packs
differs: storyline: transporting a known object to a destination, versus recovering an unknown-location object with no destination
focus: cooperation, versus search and naming
concept: cumulative journey with a travelling refrain, versus stationary question-and-answer with a reveal
narrative_axis_separation.assertion: A second production that differed from the first only in cast, palette or asset set would fail RISK-41. These two differ on all three declared axes and share only the cast and its environment, which the source expressly permits.
